title:
Base type for multi-tenant "engines" i.e. {@link Engine.Deprecated engines} that can all tenants and tags.
This means that there will be a shared instance for all tags, and caches will be shared across tags.

Multi-tenant engines are assumed not to be dependent on the types for any tag. Thus they will *not* be
restarted when provisioning occurs. Multi-tenant engines can only be implemented by platform types
(they are part of the server itself, not provisioned).

All methods exposed must be member methods. The system will use the default instance mechanism to set up or
re-use an instance when one of those methods is called.

Note that engines are *not true singletons*. While there will only be a single engine per server,
there will be an instance on each server node in the cluster.

@see Engine.Deprecated
@see SingleTenantEngine
name: MultiTenantEngine
